specific_objectives: 19.1.1.1Trainee will be able to explain aircraft wiring and Causes of wiring degradation.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of wire color coding standards; Safety: Verify power off; Supervision: Instructor monitors identification accuracy.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of aircraft wiring?
List three common causes of wiring degradation.
Why is original wire identification critical for maintenance?

development.content:
Definition of aircraft wiring system
Components of electrical wiring
Standard color coding schemes
Wire identification methods
Importance of original identification

Causes of insulation degradation
Effects of environmental exposure
Mechanical stress and fatigue
Chemical corrosion mechanisms
Thermal cycling impacts

Identification of degraded wires
Documentation of wire status
Reporting procedures for defects
Preventive maintenance measures
Replacement wire selection criteria

summary_questions: Explain the relationship between wire identification and system reliability.
Describe two specific causes of wiring degradation and their effects.
home_assignment_question: Review LP 02 syllabus and prepare a brief note on how wire identification principles apply to the next topic.
